speaker: narrator
text: It was March fifth, in the year twenty-one ten.

speaker: narrator
text: It was almost eleven at night on a remote island somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean. The island stretched roughly fifty-six kilometers across, about thirty-five miles from one side to the other, but most of it remained undeveloped wilderness. Near its center sat a research settlement of laboratories, homes, workshops, medical facilities, and other buildings supporting the nearly five hundred people who lived there.

speaker: narrator
text: Deep inside one of those laboratories, Dr. Jack Bennett was hard at work. Technically.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack sat slumped in his chair with his arms folded across his chest, his head tilted toward one shoulder, and several pages of diagnostic data glowing on the monitor in front of him. His eyes were closed.

speaker: narrator
text: A warning tone chirped from Jack's console. He shifted but did not wake. A second tone followed, louder than the first, and the diagnostic display flashed amber.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack jerked awake so quickly that his chair rolled backward and nearly struck another workstation.

speaker: narrator
text: The warning repeated while Jack rubbed his eyes and leaned toward the monitor.

speaker: narrator
text: Several windows were opening and closing on their own. Lines of commands streamed across one side of the display faster than he could read them. Jack grabbed the keyboard and opened the network monitor.

speaker: jack
text: Come on. What are you doing?

speaker: narrator
text: An unfamiliar connection appeared for half a second and vanished.

speaker: narrator
text: He refreshed the display, but the connection was gone. Another warning tone sounded from the console and a red message filled the center of his screen.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack entered a command and pulled up the laboratory access logs. Nothing looked unusual. He tried another search and got the same result.

speaker: narrator
text: The system beeped, and a directory opened by itself. Jack stopped typing when he recognized the folder.

speaker: narrator
text: He immediately locked the terminal. The screen went black for three seconds, then came back on and reopened the same directory.

speaker: jack
text: I've got something weird on my computer. It tripped a security alarm.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah leaned closer to the intercom.

speaker: jack
text: I think somebody's in the system.

speaker: narrator
text: There was a brief pause before Sarah asked,

speaker: narrator
text: Jack scanned the empty connection list.

speaker: jack
text: No. That's why I'm calling the smarter scientist.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah laughed softly through the speaker.

speaker: jack
text: Can you come take a look?

speaker: narrator
text: Jack released the intercom and looked back at the monitor. The TOMBS directory was still open.

speaker: narrator
text: The cursor moved without him touching anything.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack froze as a file opened.

speaker: narrator
text: He reached for the keyboard just as the laboratory door slid open behind him.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah Bennett stepped inside with a tablet tucked beneath one arm. She glanced from Jack to the computer.

speaker: sarah
text: Please tell me you didn't break something.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah stopped just inside the doorway.

speaker: sarah
text: You called me in here to admit that?

speaker: narrator
text: Jack pointed toward the monitor as she walked over.

speaker: jack
text: Whatever this is. I was reviewing yesterday's test results.

speaker: narrator
text: She leaned over his shoulder and studied the screen.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack straightened in his chair while Sarah placed her tablet beside the keyboard.

speaker: jack
text: Right. Problem. I got an unauthorized access warning. I checked the network monitor and saw a connection I didn't recognize, but it disappeared before I could trace it.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah tapped the edge of the keyboard.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack pointed to the open directory.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah looked at the terminal lock indicator.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah stared at him for a moment before looking back at the monitor. Jack pointed at the screen.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah started powering up the other console next to Jack.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack kept one hand on the keyboard.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah nudged the arm of his chair, looking slightly annoyed, but sympathetic.

speaker: sarah
text: Let me have your chair and get another chair.

speaker: jack
text: Oh. Of course. Anything for you.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack gave Sarah his chair, crossed to the next workstation, and dragged its chair back, wheels squeaking against the floor, before pulling himself up to his own screen.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack watched his own log scroll.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah opened the connection history on her screen.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack pulled up the TOMBS directory again, tracing back through what had changed.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah murmured after a few seconds, still scanning her own feed.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack pointed at his own screen.

speaker: jack
text: Mine too. Whoever it was covered both trails.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah narrowed her eyes at the display.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah shook her head, but Jack caught the beginning of a smile. He glanced at the time and then at her.

speaker: jack
text: You know, you're supposed to be resting.

speaker: sarah
text: No. You're the one I found asleep at a laboratory terminal.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah stopped typing long enough to look at him.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah gave him a look that answered the question for him.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack surrendered with a small nod.

speaker: sarah
text: Lately the baby seems to think eleven at night is morning.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah rested a hand briefly against her stomach, then returned to typing.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack smiled at the movement beneath her hand.

speaker: narrator
text: A new warning tone interrupted them. Both turned toward the main console as another message appeared.

speaker: narrator
text: Jack reached across the console and rejected the request.

speaker: narrator
text: He entered his administrator credentials, but a new message appeared before he could issue another command.

speaker: narrator
text: Sarah looked from the message to him.
